2013-03-14 Brisbane Entertainment Centre, Brisbane, Queensland, Australia

Share: 

Scheduled: 19:00 Local Start Time 20:00 / End Time 23:11

Info & Setlist | Venue

The first of ten shows in Australia as Springsteen performs down under for the first time in a decade. Tonight is the first show as a full band member for Tom Morello, who is standing in for Steven Van Zandt while he is filming his successful TV show Lilyhammer. Biggest surprise of the 25-song set is the tour's sole "Just Like Fire Would", a 1986 hit by Brisbane band The Saints. "My City Of Ruins" includes a snippet of "Tenth Avenue Freeze-Out". Final tour performance for the "Apollo Medley". First ever performances in Australia of "We Take Care Of Our Own", "Just Like Fire Would", "Wrecking Ball", "Death To My Hometown", "Spirit In The Night", "The E Street Shuffle", "Jack Of All Trades", "Because The Night", "Shackled And Drawn", "The Way You Do The Things You Do", "634-5789 (Soulsville, U.S.A.)", "We Are Alive", and "Tenth Avenue Freeze-Out". Greatest Hits outtake "High Hopes" is soundchecked and also setlisted as an alternative to "Shackled And Drawn". Following the soundcheck Bruce is interviewed by local press. Patti Scialfa is not present.

Sorry, no Storyteller available.

Keith Garlinge Great show many thanks to the people that organized the first entry to the GA area. Got us front of stage, as a long time Springsteen fan living in Perth Western Australia it was an opportunity I thought I'd never get. The band was superb, For me the highlight was Tom Joad, Morello was right in front of us boy can he play I got the impression he enjoyed the show as much as we did. Fantastic set list with some surprises, only regret couldn't stay for some more concerts on the East coast.
